notes.title: SCP: The Mystery Man - New ARG Coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello! Here to announce my new upcoming Alternate Reality Game.
Please add it to your wishlist. 

Dive into the enigmatic world of "The Mystery Man," an Alternate Reality Game (ARG) that blurs the lines between reality and fiction. In this immersive experience, you become the investigator, unraveling the secrets of the SCP Universe through a series of intricate puzzles and cryptic clues. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451680/SCP__Mystery_Man/

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.content:
- Added "Reset.exe" in the Downloads folder. It will help players to directly unlock the last level. For like getting the alternate ending without playing the whole game again.
- Fixed a rare bug in level 21 where the game wasn't accepting user's input.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.9.28
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where "Proud JSON Editor" achievement wasn't working
- Disabled low priority post-processing effects to give extra FPS boost
- Cleaned up credits.txt

[b]Note: If the update doesn't appear then please restart steam client.[/b]

Thanks for playing!
